Full summary: Beta enrollment drafts created (Gmail drafts-only, Dave sends): full beta.2 enrollment to Lanny.Ripple@gmail.com (first genuinely external tester, identified via GitHub issue authorship + public email), and a beta.2 delta reply on the existing dangulo@salesforce.com thread. Session wrap.
Decisions: Chose to draft a short delta reply on the existing salesforce thread rather than re-send full enrollment — that project already holds the beta.1 instructions, which remain current except the >=beta.2 requirement line; a full re-send buries the one change that matters.; Chose Lanny.Ripple@gmail.com as the external-tester recipient — only non-Dave GitHub issue author on the repo, public email, and his repos hold the real pre-1.24 archive damage, making him the ideal compact_archives field test; Dave adds any additional testers to the draft before sending.
Findings: Stable-gate note: the '≥2 external beta projects' gate counts projects, and dangulo@salesforce.com is Dave's own work address — Lanny's enrollment (Gmail draft r2930978860476125227, delta reply r-3715664772201766400) is the first genuinely external party. Until he or another outside tester enrolls, the long-pole gate has zero qualifying projects.
